about.label: About
about.title: Hiro Kuwana
about.metaDescription: Hiro Kuwana builds AI systems that do real work, in English and Japanese. Founder of Kaiwa; runs Otterd with Eric Wu.
paragraphs: I build AI systems that do real work, in English and Japanese.

I founded Kaiwa, a language-practice app I run largely on AI agents: scheduled jobs, a coding agent that opens pull requests, and drafting agents that never send on their own. Running it taught me what breaks and what a person still has to approve.

With Eric Wu, I run Otterd, which builds AI workflows for private equity and hedge fund teams. Client engagements run through Otterd. This site is where I show my own working: diagnostics of listed companies built from public filings, the method behind them, and the prompts I use.
I have been shipping software since 2018.
about.contactBody: Email is the fastest way to reach me. If it is about a diagnostic, say which one.
